summary: Dispatches two commands by selectors 25 and 26 through the object referenced by global dword_7CD8C0, comparing each dispatched object's name against this when it is non-null. Returns 0.

operations.description: Indirect __thiscall through the vtable of dword_7CD8C0 at offset 28, requesting the object for selector 25; store the returned pointer.
Guard on the first dispatched pointer being non-null before its name comparison.
Call ObjectNameComparison with the first dispatched object and this as arguments.
Indirect __thiscall through the vtable of dword_7CD8C0 at offset 28, requesting the object for selector 26; store the returned pointer.
Guard on the second dispatched pointer being non-null before its name comparison.
Call ObjectNameComparison with the second dispatched object and this as arguments.

unresolved: Identity of the dispatcher object behind dword_7CD8C0 and the meaning of selectors 25 and 26.
Semantics of ObjectNameComparison and why its result is discarded.
